summary:
Architecture:
- One home for the look: a new app/projects/rendering/studio.js. It is a plain ES module with no imports and no top-level DOM access.
  - Built mostly by moving the approved lab code: lab/studio.js, the hardware finishes from lab/materials-models.js, and the Wafer materials from lab/materials-wafer.js.
  - New glue: tone, exposure, lights, fit/modelBox, merge, LOOKS, finish.
- How it reaches the pages: build.cjs gains an `esm` source kind (Babel transform-modules-commonjs, wrapped as window.MOStudio).
  - It goes into every bundle and into the landing runtime.
  - solid-materials.js and the landing's unstamped script tag for it are deleted.
- The lab gallery and lab/studio.js import the same file natively. lab/wafer.js (the study) is not edited and keeps its 53 files.

Tone and per-model look:
- PBR Neutral lives inside every model material: a chained onBeforeCompile with a uniform exposure and key + "|neutral".
- No renderer setting and no ShaderChunk patch is used. The Universe composer cannot tone-map its render target, and every non-model material there is unlit, so cards, dust, stars, void, DoF, CA and vignette stay pixel-identical.
- The per-model look (ev, env, rim/key, finish, LED mode, table, merge) is LOOKS, keyed by the model URL every consumer already holds. Framing stays in the registries, so no new registry field is needed.

Wafer:
- One derived file, models/wafer.glb, built by tools/wafer/build.mjs: the 53 parts as named nodes, a shared key mesh, 40° creased normals baked offline, palettes as node extras, and the two MIP panels as PNG lid nodes. It carries no KTX2.
- It serves the card, reel, handoff, hero, menu, board and PLAY DEMO through the one loader cache.
- Static tiers merge by material (62 → 13 draws) on tight boxes, which equal wafer_demo's frame, so the seam is unchanged.
- Explosions keep their loose-box maths on the raw nodes, verified per part to 3e-5 m.

Performance:
- KTX2Loader and the transcoder leave the site: −265 KB and −4 requests on the landing, −29 KB and −4 requests on 7 routes, no throwaway WebGL context.
- The PMREM is built through a cube camera: 128 for field, board and menu, 256 for heroes, with no 3 MB depth buffer left behind.
- Field programs go 29 → ≤22. ZMK draws go 49 → 2. The board goes 11.3 → ≤5 ms.
- The landing board needs −53 requests and −847 KB; Wafer.html needs −7 requests and −280 KB.
- The hero sleeps under PLAY DEMO, dt is clamped, and field models are precompiled at load.

Riskiest decisions:
- Kerfur, the node proxy and the menu switch get the new look without having been judged in the gallery.
- The gltfpack flags (-vtf -kv -ke) must keep the palette UVs and extras. The build asserts it.
- Merged float geometry adds about 4 MB per context.
- The landing gets heavier only from Venovisor (+103 KB, decision 4) and the float-position Ci-Clop (+11 KB). Both are named in the budget.
core_api:
window.MOStudio is the export set of app/projects/rendering/studio.js. The build inlines it into every page bundle and into app/landing/runtime.js; the lab imports the file natively.

CONSTANTS
- TONE = {exposure: 1, toe: 1} (frozen)
- NEUTRAL_GLSL: "uniform float uExposure, uToe;" + vec3 neutral(vec3)
- ROOM = {wall .05, floor .1, top 2, back 7, key 8, rimL 16, rimR 20, fill 1.4, side 3}
- FIELD_ROOM = {...ROOM, fill: 4}
- FIELD_AMBIENT = 1.0
- HW_STAGE = {mat: {env 1, floor .02}}
- LOGO_STAGE = {mat: {env .3, floor .04}}
- METALS = [{names, stage}] (chrome env 1, pearl env 1.8)
- VENO_OLIVE = "#8a8560"
- LED_MODES {off, subtle, on}
- PRESETS, BY_NAME (lab tables, verbatim)
- WAFER_URL = "models/wafer.glb"
- LOOKS = {[modelUrl]: Look}
- PROCEDURAL = {kind: "procedural", rim: 2.2, key: 2.5}

TYPE
Look = {
  kind: "logo" | "hardware" | "wafer" | "procedural",
  ev?, env?, rim?, key?,
  finish?: "venovisor" | "ciclop" | "softoff",
  led?: "off" | "subtle" | "on",
  table?, merge?: true
}

FUNCTIONS
- look(url?) -> Look
  LOOKS[url], else {kind: "logo"} when a url is given, else PROCEDURAL.
- exposure(ev = 0) -> {value: TONE.exposure * 2**ev}
- tone(material, uExposure = exposure()) -> material
  - Puts PBR Neutral inside the material: it chains onBeforeCompile and sets customProgramCacheKey = prior + "|neutral".
  - It is a no-op for toneMapped:false or an already-toned material.
  - Call it again on any clone.
- studioRoom(THREE, room) -> THREE.Scene
- studioEnvironment(THREE, renderer, room = ROOM, size = 256) -> THREE.WebGLRenderTarget
  - Built with a cube camera and PMREMGenerator.fromCubemap: no blur, no depth buffer.
  - The caller uses .texture and disposes the target.
- presets(THREE, stage) -> {anodisedBlack(arg, opts), …, apply(root, table = BY_NAME) -> {unmapped}}
  - opts.grain === false skips grain.
  - All grain shares one program key, "studio-grain".
- finish(THREE, root, url, {tier: "rig" | "field" | "parts"}) -> {look, materials: Set<Material>, exposure}
  - root is a fresh loadProjectModel clone, un-parented, with identity transform. Call finish BEFORE the fit.
  - It runs presets, the finish named by LOOKS, the Wafer assembly, then merge on non-"parts" tiers, then tone().
  - materials holds only the materials it created. The caller owns and disposes those.
  - Textures and geometry are loader- or module-shared and are never disposed by a caller.
- lights(THREE, scene) -> {set(look)}
  - Adds AmbientLight + rim DirectionalLight 0xdfe8ff at (-3.2, 2.2, -3) + key DirectionalLight at (2.5, 3.4, 2.6).
  - The light count is constant. The ambient is 0.8 for logos; rim and key come from the look.
- modelBox(THREE, root, box?) -> Box3
  World box of every object with geometry, except names matching /glow|halo|haze/.
- fit(THREE, root, size) -> Box3
  fitModelToSize's contract, computed on modelBox.
- merge(THREE, root)
  - One float mesh per material, baked into root space.
  - The geometry is memoised per page by source geometry and material name.

model-viewer.jsx
- window.fitModelToSize(root, THREE, size) delegates to MOStudio.fit. Callers are unchanged.
- window.loadProjectModel(url, THREE) keeps its cached root.clone(true) contract; the KTX2 path is gone.
- window.preloadModels(urls) is unchanged.

FILE CONTRACT for models/wafer.glb
- The 53 part nodes are named like models/wafer_parts/*.glb.
- screen_L and screen_R are children of display_L and display_R: a quad carrying a PNG panel texture.
- extras.palette (which becomes userData.palette) sits on switches_L/R and display_L/R as [[hex, roughness, metalness, tag?]]. tag "active" marks the panel area.
- The frame is the old wafer_demo frame: Z-up, metres.
- All key_* nodes share one mesh.
- The only textures are the 2 PNG panels.
- extensionsRequired ⊆ {KHR_mesh_quantization, EXT_meshopt_compression}.

gltfpack 1.3 might drop the untextured palette UVs or the node extras despite -kv -ke -vtf. The pack asserts fail loudly if so. The fallback is gltf-transform's own quantize+meshopt (the tail of $PORT/wafer/crease.mjs): heavier, and still checked against the 630,153 B gzip ceiling.

Explosion frame: default fixed-point positions make gltfpack insert dequantisation nodes, which is why consumers must use attach(), never add(). If any part's loose box moves more than 3e-5 m, repack with -vpf (float positions, no extra nodes) at a byte cost.
The Wafer's normals are packed to 8 bits, against the gallery's float bake. If the gallery diff exceeds 2%, repack with -vn 12 (a few KB more).

Stale GLB cache: model URLs carry no ?v= stamp and Pages caches for 10 minutes. A returning visitor can briefly pair the new, stamped registry with the old ci-clop-mark.glb, which has no materials and the old 90° frame, so it renders white and turned until max-age expires.

Merge by material costs about 4 MB of float GPU geometry per context that holds a static Wafer, ZMK or Sightseeing, plus about 4 MB of JS heap for the per-page memo. Within a merged mesh, transparent triangles are not depth-sorted during a card fade, as was already true of wafer_demo's 5 meshes.
Two gated single-line choices might fail their gates: Venovisor's glow at 256² (revert to 512², still shared) and forceSinglePass on the 12 card materials (revert the line).

r160 Material.copy() does not copy onBeforeCompile or customProgramCacheKey, so any future clone of a studio material silently loses Neutral, grain and layer lines. It is documented in AGENTS.md; tone() is idempotent and must be re-applied to clones.
Real-GPU and phone frame time are unmeasured. SwiftShader gives counts, not GPU time. Precompiling at load moves shader link time; it does not remove it.
